heading.en: Multiply by place value and add

hook.en: A website colour code says 7D for green. How much green is that out of 255? Let us convert it to decimal.
hook.kn: ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಬಣ್ಣ ಸಂಕೇತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಸಿರಿಗೆ 7D ಇದೆ. 255 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಅದು ಎಷ್ಟು? ಅದನ್ನು ದಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸೋಣ.

objectives.en: Convert binary, octal and hexadecimal numbers to decimal

body.en: To convert a number in base b to decimal, multiply each digit by its place value (b raised to its position) and add the products. Positions to the left of the point are 0, 1, 2, … and those to the right are −1, −2, … For example, $(101.101)_2 = 4 + 0 + 1 + 0.5 + 0 + 0.125 = 5.625$.
